# WB1 · Tổng quan

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · page · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/dashboard`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#dashboard`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#metric`
- Page key `dashboard` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"dashboard\"]"}; it must show "Tổng quan".

- Route: `/dashboard` · status: **built (U2)** · U step: U2

Kit components used: Button×15, Tile×8, Card×3, PageHeading×1, TableShell×1; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

- 1920×1020: no layout change
- 1280×720: no layout change
